name: reflectory
description: Turn the friction in your sessions into rules that persist. Works with Codex and Claude Code, sharing one rule layer and one personal git repo.

interface.shortDescription: Harvest rules from your own sessions
interface.longDescription: At the end of a session, reflectory walks back through the conversation, finds the places where you had to correct the agent, and proposes concrete changes to your rules and skills. You approve each one; approved changes land in a private git repo you own, so they survive machine changes and reach both Codex and Claude Code.
